title: Release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for release-day cutover (notes to self).

Context:
- Release: 2026.03.03 - infra + serving-runtime rollout (canary -> 50% -> 100%)
- Target windows: 09:00-12:00 PT for canary, 13:00-16:00 PT for ramp.
- Owners: Maya (cutover lead), Evan (DB migrations), Priya (traffic routing), Tom (SRE pager)

Pre-cutover (today / morning):
- [ ] Confirm night build artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-releases/2026-03-03/ (checked 02:15) — TODO double-check checksums
- [ ] Smoke tests pass on staging (staging-rt-1): last run 02:40, flaky: embedding tests
- [ ] Postmortem notes from last deploy reviewed (link CONFLUENCE-REQS-1234)
- [ ] Verify canary config in rollout service: canary duration = 45m, rollback TTL = 5m
- [ ] Notify #release-notifications 15m before start (standby list pinned)
- [ ] Ensure on-call rotation: Tom confirmed, backup is Akiko

Cutover runbook highlights (short):
1) Freeze consumer config changes 30m before canary.
2) Kick off canary job via release CLI: `redwood release start --env prod --canary` (Maya)
3) Watch key metrics: 95p latency, error-rate, token-cost-variance; dashboard: /dashboards/release-2026-03-03
4) If latency > 2x baseline or error-rate > 0.5% for 5m => rollback to previous model variant and notify SRE (Tom)
5) After stable canary, schedule progressive rollout: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, wait 15m between steps.

Backports / patches we might need (quick list):
- Backport A: PR-418 (kv-cache hotfix) - reason: reduces mem spike on long-context; owner: Evan -> candidate for hotfix during canary if mem > threshold
- Backport B: PR-419 (serve route TTL fix) - owner: Priya -> low risk, queued
- Backport C: PR-420 (model weights quantization metadata) - owner: research team; needs verification on canary node

Communication snippets (for Slack/Email) - draft templates:
- Slack (pre-start): "Heads up: Starting canary rollout for 2026.03.03 release in 15m. Maya (lead), Evan (db), Priya (traffic). Monitoring: /dashboards/release-2026-03-03. Ping @here for visible regressions."
- Email (post-100%): "Release 2026.03.03 completed to prod. No regressions observed in the 2-hour ramp. See metrics: <dashboard link>. Action items: schedule post-release audit and close backport PRs."

Known risks & mitigations (notes):
- Risk: Long-tail token generation latency spikes under heavy batching. Mitigation: revert batching config to baseline for affected model family; have revert script ready at /ops/reverts/revert-batching.sh
- Risk: DB index rebuild may impact internal telemetry writes. Mitigation: pause non-essential telemetry ingestion during 09-11 PT window

Quick run notes (to capture during run):
- 09:00 - started canary (job id: rel-20260303-can-01)
- 09:12 - observed 0.2% 5xx on route /v1/generate — investigating (Evan)
- 09:17 - root cause likely misrouted traffic to old pool; Priya adjusted routing policy to respect model-tag header -> errors fell back to 0.03%
- 09:45 - canary stable, metrics within SLO, proceeding to ramp -> 10% (started 09:50)
- 10:10 - memory spike on canary node rtx-a-07; flagged for hotfix (Evan) - note: consider PR-418 backport if recurs

Post-cutover TODOs (immediate):
- [ ] Open post-release ticket with logs and timeline (JIRA-REL-987 assigned to Maya)
- [ ] Triaging backport PRs (PR-418, PR-419, PR-420) - label: backport-needed
- [ ] Update runbook with any deviations and lessons learned
- [ ] Schedule 1hr retro with release team tomorrow morning

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the revert steps prominent in slack message. People ignore long runbooks under pressure.
- If we hit model perf regression, fallback to smaller quantized variant first — less disruptive than full rollback.
- Double-check that the billing alarms are muted for the cost spike test traffic window (otherwise paging finance)

Scratch / scratch TODOs: (one-line quick)
- check v2 routing policy TTL config
- confirm KMS key rotation window not overlapping with rollout
- remind product about user-facing note (if >1% errors)

End of scratchpad. Will copy final checklist to Confluence after cleanup.

-- maya
